answer: Seats fade: each epoch a seat's vote decays to zero unless it posts a signed whisper renewing it with basalt. Basalt is minted only for judged work, and fable records which key earned every coin. The k-th seat renewed in one epoch with basalt from one earner pays k basalt, so a lone honest seat pays 1 basalt per epoch. An operator keeping 100 clones alive on one earner's coins pays 5,050 basalt every epoch, or must buy basalt from unrelated earners at their price.
